purpose: Full-corpus structural audit: feasibility, trajectory consistency, conflict design, and grader extraction behavior. Discovery, not held-out evaluation.

detectors.name: feasibility
detectors.implementation: parse each exp_cal_state constraint (after/before/between/at/null) into a start-window; brute-force non-overlap scheduling over event orderings within 10:00-16:00

detectors.name: trajectory_conflict
detectors.implementation: replicate grader time_to_minutes + extract_json_list + is_event_conflicting; run over every assistant turn

detectors.name: conflict_design
detectors.implementation: naive earliest-placement overlap test over exp_cal_state windows

detectors.name: grader_extraction_witness
detectors.implementation: evidence/ER-f412381d/witness_extract.py (verbatim shipped extract_json_list on crafted correct responses)

limits: Static analysis only. No NeMo Gym rollout, tool server, or POST /verify executed.
Grader behavior read at Gym commit d96b337; production pin not confirmed.
Feasibility/trajectory checks reimplement the grader's parsing; exact-equivalence to the deployed verifier assumed, not proven end-to-end.
Agent-assisted adjudication; not independent human validation.
Clean structural results are checked-no-defect outcomes, not a label that the corpus is free of all possible problems.
